answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in signal, verified in cipher, and grove names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 42 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 9 hours of verification and 3 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
